name: Buy In 2
definition: Specifies elements related to the confirmation sent by the central counterparty to the clearing member in the context of the buy in process.

BuyInNotificationIdentification.name: Buy In Notification Identification
BuyInNotificationIdentification.definition: Indicates the reference of the BuyInNotification message.

BuyInIdentification.name: Buy In Identification
BuyInIdentification.definition: Indicates the reference id of the buy in.

Date.name: Date
Date.definition: Provides the date at which the buy occured.

Price.name: Price
Price.definition: Provides the price of the buy-in.

SecuritiesBuyIn.name: Securities Buy In
SecuritiesBuyIn.definition: Specifies the elements related to the securities that the central counterparty had to buy in the context of the buy-in process.

RequiredCashCompensation.name: Required Cash Compensation
RequiredCashCompensation.definition: Provides details about the cash compensation required, in case the central counterparty could not buy the securities to cover the trade(s) that failed.
